overview: This 206-page file traces Japan’s wartime gold exports, production, reserves, and controls through consular reports, statistics, translated regulations, and press clippings. Diplomatic correspondence investigates Japanese gold shipments to Latin America in 1941. Later records address military yen design and currency arrangements in Japanese-controlled and liberated territories in 1944.
interest: The file connects Japan’s gold policy with a 1941 diplomatic investigation and 1944 plans for military and occupation currency.
